FULL TEXT:

Initiatives under E-Courts Project
GAUHATI HIGH COURT,
ITANAGAR PERMANENT BENCH,
ARUNACHAL PRADESH
Transforming Judiciary with the use of Information Technology
Shri Tailang Laji
Central Project Coordinator, E-Courts Project
Gauhati High Court, Itanagar Permanent Bench
Arunachal Pradesh
“The implementation of E-Courts Project in the State of Arunachal Pradesh has
marked a significant leap towards improving the justice delivery system. It has
made our processes more efficient, transparent, and accessible - both for the
Court staff and the public. It is a positive change that brings justice
closer to the people”.
Overview
• Case Information System (CIS)
• Hardware Infrastructure
• National Judicial Data Grid (NJDG)
• E-Courts Technical Manpower
• Application Software Development
• eSewa Kendra
• Video Conferencing and Live Streaming of Case Proceedings
• E-Courts Capacity Building Programme
• District Court Websites under S3WaaS
• Scanning and Digitization of Case Records
• Inter-Operable Criminal Justice System (ICJS)
• National Service Tracking of Electronic Processes (NSTEP)
• Network Connectivity in District Courts
• eGRAS (Electronic Government Receipt Accounting System)
• eOffice in High Court
Case Information System
IMPLEMENTATION | UPGRADATION | MAINTENANCE
1. The implementation of Case Information
System (CIS) under eCourts Project and its
upgradation to latest version 4.0 in our district
courts of Arunachal Pradesh marks a
significant leap toward improving the justice
delivery system.
2. It has made our processes more efficient,
transparent, and accessible - both for the court
staff and the public.
3. Now, case status, hearing dates, and orders
are just a click away through eCourts Services
Mobile Application and Web Portal.
MILESTONE ACHIEVED: CIS 4.0 IMPLEMENTED IN ALL 31 DISTRICT COURTS
Hardware Infrastructure
ASSESSMENT | PROCUREMENT | MAINTENANCE
1. Hardware Infrastructure being most vital to execute
eCourts Project were procured via Government
eMarketplace (GeM) after making proper requirement
assessment for each and every Court. Hardwares
items like Computers, Scanners, Printers, Servers,
Video Conferencing equipments, Solar Power, etc
were provided to all Courts in Arunachal Pradesh
under phased manner.
2. Further, assessment was made for additional
requirement of hardware for newly opened Court
Complexes.
MILESTONE ACHIEVED: HARDWARE PROVIDED TO ALL 31 DISTRICT COURTS
National Judicial Data Grid
DATA REPLICATION | ONLINE ACCESS | SERVICES PORTAL
Integration of Case Information System (CIS) with
National Judicial Data Grid (NJDG) and eCourts
Services Portal made the case related data available
on online portals and mobile application of eCourts for
access to common public, advocates, litigants, etc.
As of now, total 15 District Courts of Arunachal
Pradesh where eCourts network is available are
successfully replicating data to NJDG and another 16
District Courts are in the pipeline to go live in coming
days.
MILESTONE ACHIEVED: 15 DISTRICT COURTS ARE LIVE WITH DATA REPLICATING ON
NJDG PORTAL
eCourts Technical Manpower
RECRUITMENT | DEPLOYEMENT | CONTINUATION
Technical Manpower
under Phase II and
Phase III of eCourts
were recruited for
High Court and
District Courts. These
manpower are
responsible for maintenance of Software application
development, CIS Server configuration / maintenance,
network connectivity, IT hardware maintenance and
overall eCourts Project implementation in their
respective District Courts.
Timely renewal/extension of technical manpower’s
employment is done to ensure smooth and timely
implementation of the eCourts project in the State.
MILESTONE ACHIEVED: ALL 31 DISTRICT COURTS ARE MANNED WITH TECHNICAL
STAFFS IN TWO PHASE.
Application Software Development
DEVELOPMENT | LAUNCH | USAGE
As a part of eCourts Project, several inefficiencies were identified in the Registry where the existing manual
processes carried out by Staffs led to delays and reduced productivity. To address these challenges, we
implemented digital solutions in terms of software development. Some of the key development under this initiative
includes: -
• Online Recruitment Portal
• Record Room Management System
• Monthly Statement Portal
• Employee ID Card Application System
eSEWA KENDRA
PROCUREMENT | CONSTRUCTION | LAUNCH
1. Under eCourts Project, the eSewa Kendra
is established to functions as a one-stop
helpdesk for the advocates and the general
public.
2. It provides essential services such as
case status, cause lists, certified copy
information, and distribution of court-related
forms - all in one place.
3. A dedicated manpower is provided for
manning the eSewa Kendras in District
Courts and High Court.
4. It is a major step toward citizen-friendly
justice delivery.
MILESTONE ACHIEVED: eSEWA KENDRA ESTABLISHED IN 30 DISTRICT COURTS
Video Conferencing & Live Streaming
COURT | PRISON | HOSPITAL
1. Video Conferencing System as a part of
eCourts Project is provided to all the Courts
including High Court in the State of Arunachal
Pradesh. It has proven effective for recording
evidence, remanding accused persons and
conducting bail hearings, thus reducing logistical
burdens and ensuring timely justice.
2. Live Streaming of Court Proceeding is done
in High Court along with recruitment of a
dedicated manpower for the said activity. This
has enhanced transparency, reduces delays and
minimizes the need for physical appearances
MILESTONE ACHIEVED: VC EQUIPMENTS PROVIDED TO ALL 31 DISTRICT COURTS, 21
DISTRICT GOVERNMENT HOSPITALS AND 08 JAILS.
Capacity Building Program
JUDICIAL OFFICERS | ADMIN OFFICERS | STAFFS
1. In collaboration with Judicial Academy, Assam
zone-wise ECT training conducted for Judicial
Officers, Court Staffs, Advocates at Judicial
Academy, Assam and at 03 Districts of
Arunachal Pradesh namely Naharlagun,
Pasighat and Tezu. A good number of
participants attended and got benefitted from
the said training programme.
MILESTONE ACHIEVED: TOTAL 14 PHYSICAL CAPACITY BUILDING PROGRAMMES
CONDUCTED DURING FY 2024-25

District Court Website – S3WaaS
CONFIGURATION | LAUNCH | UPDATE
S3WaaS is a cloud service developed for
Government entities to generate Secure,
Scalable & Sugamya websites. A total of 21
District Court’s website is upgraded using
S3WaaS framework.
MILESTONE ACHIEVED: 21 DISTRICT COURT’S WEBSITE HOSTED UNDER S3WAAS
Scanning & Digitization
SCANNING | QUALITY CHECK | STORAGE
1. To enable a total digital and paperless Court,
scanning of all case records initiated in High
Court and District Courts of Arunachal Pradesh.
2. A secure Document Management System is
being developed under eCourts project to store
and retrieve these case record for future use.
While scanning, proper quality check of every
case record is done to ensure proper readability
and accuracy of digitized case record.
MILESTONE ACHIEVED: 4.60 LAKHS IMAGES SCANNED AS ON 31.05.2025
Inter-Operable Criminal Justice System
FIR | CHARGESHEET CONSUMPTION | VERIFICATION
1. The integration of ICJS with CIS is a crucial
advancement under the eCourts project in
Arunachal Pradesh.
2. This integration enabled our District Courts
to seamlessly access and verify FIRs and
charge sheets submitted by the respective
Police Stations through the ICJS platform.
3. Once verified, these documents are directly
registered in the CIS, eliminating duplication
and delays.
4. This integration not only saves time but also
enhances accuracy and inter-agency
coordination in criminal justice processes.
MILESTONE ACHIEVED: 15 DISTRICT COURT’S CIS ARE INTEGRATED WITH ICJS
National Service Tracking of
Electronic Processes (NSTEP)
PROCESS GENERATION | ALLOCATION | SERVING
1. NSTEP is implemented in 15 District Courts
of Arunachal Pradesh. Process is generated via
Case Information System and is served to the
person concerned through NSTEP mobile
application. Transaction and status of any
process is stored digitally and can be accessed
at any time.
2. Smartphone is provided to all the Process
Server of District Courts for serving processes
through NSTEP mobile application.
MILESTONE ACHIEVED: NSTEP implemented in 15 District Courts. Smartphones distributed
to 31 Process Servers.
Network Connectivity
MPLS | SDWAN | VSAT
1. A secure and fast network connectivity in
provided to District Courts under the project.
Out of total 31 District Courts, 15 Courts are
already connected via eCourts MPLS network
and the remaining 16 Courts are under process.
2. The remaining 15 Courts will be connected
via SDWAN technology either through VSAT
or Optical Fiber Cable including a Secondary
Connectivity for High Court.
MILESTONE ACHIEVED: MPLS NETWORK – 15 COURTS , SDWAN – 15 COURTS
E-Government Receipt Accounting
System (eGRAS)
ACCOUNTS CREATION | TRAINING | IMPLEMENTATION
1. In collaboration with National Informatics
Centre, Itanagar State Unit, eGras was
implemented for all the District Courts of
Arunachal Pradesh.
2. Training was conducted for the staffs before
going live. As on today Courts are receiving the
Fine and Forfeitures using eGras.
MILESTONE ACHIEVED: eGRAS IMPLEMENTED IN 31 DISTRICT COURTS
eOFFICE
PLANNING | PRE-REQUISITE | TRAINING | IMPLEMENTATION
1. To make the High Court a digital workplace
with paperless environment, eOffice project
was initiated under eCourts. eOffice will not
only bring a paperless environment but will also
save the transaction time and overall security of
files.
2. All the Master data is prepared and feeded
into eOffice application, infrastructure for
implementing eOffice is made available and
hosting is done on Railtel Data Centre. eOffice
is now ready for an Official launch in the
Itanagar Bench of Gauhati High Court.
eCourts Project, Gauhati High Court, Itanagar Permanent Bench
Yupia, Arunachal Pradesh
